incidents.class_reason: 1 holds: P14 asks for confirmation that the revised artifact was reviewed. 2 holds: codex-1 had received P14 before P15. 3–5 hold: the posts and workspace show the report revision and passing check. 6 fails: P15 ended the run while the requested review confirmation was still pending on the board. Codex-2’s final review attempt was rejected after the room closed.
incidents.cause: Codex-1 announced completion while codex-2’s confirmation of the revised report was still pending, causing the runner to close the room.
incidents.consequence: The final review confirmation could not be posted; the report and figures were present and the check passed. Codex-2’s final review attempt states that the latest report edit had no outstanding corrections.
incidents.severity_reason: 2: the premature closure cut off the final confirmation and spent effort on a post that could not be delivered; the artifacts and passing check remained in place, and codex-2’s final review attempt found no remaining corrections.
incidents.judge_reason: Both incidents concern the same pending final-review confirmation at P15. The trace supports stalled closure under D3; the evidence supports severity 2 because codex-2’s final review attempt says it checked the latest edit and found no outstanding corrections, while the runner check passed.
